text:
ana: Noticed a cluster-wide attach jitter in ap-southeast1 starting ~30m after the nightly janitor window. NVMe scrub backlog spiked and local pool saturation started rejecting preemptible scratch.

ops-bot: [alert] region=ap-southeast1 metric=nvme_iops severity=high value=16500 baseline=7200

lee: any new kernel or janitor changes rolled in recently?

ana: No kernel. We did push janitor tweak 2 nights ago to be more aggressive on hotwalk to clear long-lived tempfiles. It was rolled full-region at 02:00UTC.

devon: that aligns. Aggressive hotwalk -> more writes -> flushes -> write amplification on some older drives. If scrub/backlog stomps the hot pool, attach-provisioner waits for space and that causes the GPU attach stalls.

mira-support: seeing customer tickets now for Dedicated attach timeouts in sg1/ap-southeast1. Raising a banner to affected tenants.

lee: can we throttle janitor at region-level while we repair? `rvctl svc config set janitor --region ap-southeast1 --concurrency=2 --apply-immediately`

ops-bot: [info] config-change scheduled by lee for janitor/ap-southeast1

ana: Doing a soft throttle first. Also starting a conservative reclaim pass to free hot extents: `janitor reclaim --region ap-southeast1 --mode=targeted --limit=150 --sleep=300ms`

k8s-bot: [action] scheduler: reduced max-attach-per-node=2 in ap-southeast1

devon: watch nvme_smart_counters and host write_queue_depth. If we unbalance reclaim we might trigger firmware thermal throttles on older PMs. Let's stream metrics.

(8m later)

ops-bot: [metric] ap-southeast1 nvme_iops=9800 attach_queue=9 -> 4 after throttle

ana: reclaim pass freed ~1200MB across 9 nodes, attach queue decreased but still seeing tail 95p latency ~9s.

lee: We should also enable pre-warmed scratch routing for low-priority jobs so they don't block attaches. `scheduler.fallback_mode=prewarm` per region.

devon: longer-term: add scrub-cost-estimates to the janitor preflight. It should refuse to start full hotwalk if predicted delta > 1.5x baseline_iops for the region. Also we need a canary rollout (5 nodes) before full region.

mira-support: customers updated: "We're mitigating a transient storage reclaim surge in ap-southeast1 that increased GPU attach latency. Workaround applied; we expect normal behavior to resume within 1 hour."

ana: quick cost note: We can spin replacement instances for the most impacted nodes (~18) which would restore immediate capacity but we'd pay ~+$2.6k in spot churn and data-migration time. Recommendation: continue throttle + reclaim; replacement only if attach queue doesn't recover in 45m.

lee: agree. Also file a follow-up to add device age tags into monitoring so janitor can reduce concurrency on hosts older than X TBW.

devon: logging action items: 1) revert aggressive hotwalk flag in janitor config and schedule a staged canary, 2) add preflight iops prediction for reclaim jobs, 3) add pre-warm scratch fallback to scheduler, 4) add device-age-based throttle, 5) update runbook with exact `rvctl` commands and thresholds.

ana: applied config change at 2026-03-23T13:05Z to reduce janitor concurrency in ap-southeast1. Monitoring on the thread for 1h.

ops-bot: [info] janitor.ap-southeast1 concurrency=2 applied

k8s-bot: [info] scheduler fallback_mode=prewarm applied in ap-southeast1

mira-support: I'll keep customers informed.

ana: thanks everyone. If attach queue recovers to <3 and nvme_iops stabilizes under 9k in 30m we'll close this. If not, we escalate to replacement plan. :coffee:
